screening.grading: Automatic fact checks for synthetic scenes; human scene-grounded review for 24 real-scene outputs

findings.gpt54-none: 5/6 real quality passes; one Slack draft treated a reported permissions response as proof the issue was resolved.
findings.mini-none: 2/6 real passes; all three corrected-browser repeats selected the wrong conversation; Slack drafts lost timeline/latest-action information.
findings.luna-none: 4/6 real passes; two LinkedIn drafts were English despite Japanese source-language instruction.
findings.luna-low: 4/6 real passes; Japanese and conversation association correct in all six real outputs; two Slack drafts omitted read-only access.

economics.fxStatus: Repository planning assumption, not current exchange rate
economics.formula: ((input tokens × standard input rate + total completion tokens × output rate) / 1000000) × 150 × 1000
economics.basis: Mean measured token usage on six real-scene repetitions per condition. Total completion includes reasoning; do not add it again.
economics.cacheAssumption: No cached-input discount applied. Not an actual invoice. If every Luna input token is charged at the $0.125/M cache-write rate rather than $0.10/M, low increases from ¥85.26 to ¥96.075 per 1000 real calls.
economics.volumeAssumption: 1000 model calls, not 1000 distinct users or necessarily actual monthly consumption

limitations: Only two real scenes repeated three times; pass counts are not population accuracy estimates
Five synthetic scenes largely share one family; corrected browser contains footer answer-key confound
Sequential model order, no independent blinded judge
Saved-capture replay tests model behavior, not capture/staleness/abstention or full native interaction
Provider latency excludes capture and UI; replay wall includes launch/auth/network
No image-vs-text comparison, so this experiment cannot attribute output quality differences to image input
